name: GEOHAN
recent: Geohan 于 2026 年 8 月 24 日宣布获得 Chin Hin Property 一份价值 RM37mil 的高层住宅土方工程合约。公司同日发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度业绩，营收环比增长 17.7%，但录得净亏损。董事经理 Lee Kim Seng 于 8 月 26 日及 28 日在公开市场增持公司股份。
notable: 获得 Chin Hin Property 价值 RM37mil 的高层住宅土方工程合约。
董事经理 Lee Kim Seng 于 8 月 26 日及 28 日合计增持约 606 万股。
risks: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度录得净亏损 RM0.97mil，净利率为 -0.8%。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM121.821mil，环比增长 17.7%；净亏损为 RM0.97mil，净利率 -0.8%，上一季度净利率为 1.4%。

recent_en: On 24 Aug 2026, Geohan announced a RM37mil earthwork contract for a high-rise residential project from Chin Hin Property. The company also released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on the same day, with revenue up 17.7% QoQ but a net loss recorded. Managing Director Lee Kim Seng acquired shares in the open market on 26 and 28 August.
notable_en: Secured a RM37mil earthwork contract for a high-rise residential project from Chin Hin Property.
Managing Director Lee Kim Seng acquired a total of approximately 6.06 million shares on 26 and 28 August.
risks_en: Recorded a net loss of RM0.97mil for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, with a net margin of -0.8%.
earnings_en: Revenue for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 was RM121.821mil, up 17.7% QoQ; net loss was RM0.97mil with a net margin of -0.8%, versus a net margin of 1.4% in the previous quarter.
